# SQL Developer – AI Prompting & Context Engineering

* On-site, Remote, Hybrid
* + Bromley, England, United Kingdom

## Job description

This is a dual role, split between approximately 60% AI-assisted development and agent orchestration, and 40% SQL Server development supporting large-scale data migration. You’ll work within the development team and report to the Software Manager, combining practical AI skills with strong SQL expertise to deliver reliable, efficient solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI-Assisted Development & Agent Orchestration (c. 60%)**

* Use AI coding assistants, such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, across the development lifecycle, including code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation and review.
* Build and maintain effective prompts, system instructions, reusable skills and context to produce consistent, reliable AI outputs.
* Design and orchestrate agents and multi-agent workflows, including task decomposition, tool use, agent hand-offs and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Connect agents to internal systems, databases and APIs, for example through MCP or function calling.
* Evaluate AI output for accuracy, regression, cost and latency, and refine workflows based on results.
* Apply appropriate safeguards for data privacy, security and hallucination risk, particularly when customer or school data is involved.
* Identify and prototype opportunities to apply AI to development and data migration, and share best practice by supporting and coaching colleagues.

**SQL Server & Data Migration (c. 40%)**

* Design, develop and maintain scalable SQL Server T-SQL solutions and related tools for data cleansing, migration and reconciliation.
* Provide database performance-tuning expertise for internal and third-party systems, using AI tooling where appropriate.
* Define technical requirements with non-technical colleagues in the Data Migration Team, and work with third parties to understand their software and support migration projects.
* Manage SQL Server database environments used for data migration, including backup and recovery in test environments.
* Prepare and expose data safely for agents and AI workflows, using AI to support SQL query generation, code review and optimisation.
* Plan and prioritise work independently, managing tasks against project timelines and requirements.

**The Ideal Candidate**

* You’ll combine hands-on AI-assisted development skills with substantial SQL Server experience. You’ll be curious and adaptable, communicate clearly, and use good judgement to assess AI-generated output rather than accepting it uncritically.
* Demonstrable experience using AI coding tools and writing effective prompts, with practical examples of workflows or agents you have built.
* Substantial SQL programming experience and strong knowledge of the techniques and capabilities of Microsoft SQL Server 2017 or later.
* A strong grounding in data modelling, data management and data manipulation, alongside Git, version control and attention to detail.
* The ability to investigate problems independently, collaborate with colleagues and communicate clearly in writing and in person.

**Essential Skills**

Practical experience with AI coding assistants and strong prompting skills, supported by examples.

Strong SQL Server T-SQL development and performance tuning, including experience supporting SQL Server in a large-scale environment.

Experience with Git and version control.

Excellent teamwork, communication and documentation skills.

**Desirable Skills**

Experience building agents or multi-agent workflows using Claude Code, MCP or similar frameworks.

Familiarity with LLM APIs, evaluation approaches and prompt testing.

Scripting or programming experience in Python or a similar language.

Awareness of AI data protection and security considerations.

A reasonable understanding of operating systems, infrastructure and networking.

# Technical Operations Engineer

London, England, United Kingdom

CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with omniscient systems purpose-built for today’s realities. Designed and built by top U.S. military veterans and Silicon Valley innovators, CHAOS Industries’ products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDNTM), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. In a world where technological threats move at unprecedented speed, CHAOS Industries delivers advanced sensing and detection solutions that give the ultimate advantage: time.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised $1B in total funding from leading investors including 8VC, Accel, and NEA. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview**:

Technical Operations Engineers sit at the intersection of technology and real-world mission environments. You’ll ensure CHAOS systems operate flawlessly in the field — integrating hardware and software, diagnosing complex system issues, and delivering rapid fixes and improvements.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in dynamic, hands-on settings — comfortable with Linux terminals, network traces, and hardware wiring as much as Python scripts and dashboards. You’ll be embedded with customers, integrating CHAOS systems into existing infrastructure, and ensuring reliability under real-world conditions.

**Responsibilities**:

* Integrate CHAOS software, sensors, and RF devices with customer systems — both physically (networking, power, and hardware bring-up) and via software interfaces (data pipelines, APIs).
* Debug complex edge issues spanning hardware, software, and networking layers.
* Develop scripts, diagnostics, and automation tools to improve reliability and observability.
* Capture operational feedback and collaborate with internal engineering teams to drive product improvements.
* Document system configurations, troubleshooting steps, and lessons learned for both internal and customer audiences.
* Travel (typically up to 50%) to customer and test sites for deployments, troubleshooting, and mission support.

**Minimum Requirements**:

* Strong technical foundation with a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or related field — or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Deep familiarity with Linux environments; comfortable with SSH, networking tools, and system-level debugging.
* Strong problem-solving instincts — able to work independently and under pressure in the field.
* Understanding of networking protocols, hardware interfaces, and distributed system concepts.
* Experience integrating or maintaining hardware or sensor systems.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Bash, or similar).
* Willingness and enthusiasm for travel and on-site technical work.

**Preferred Requirements**:

* Experience in systems integration, field engineering, or technical operations for complex deployments.
* Background in defense, aerospace, or other mission-critical environments.
* Familiarity with telemetry, data integration, or IoT-style architectures.
* Understanding of RF systems, SDRs, or radar technologies (highly valued but not required).
* Experience with cloud and edge computing environments (Docker, Azure, AWS, etc.).
* Excellent communication and documentation skills — able to bridge technical and operational perspectives with clarity and composure.

**Why CHAOS?**

* **Health Benefits:**Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
* **Additional benefits**: 5% pension match, life insurance, Cycle to Work Scheme, and more
* **Our Perks:**Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
* **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
* **Team Growth:** 350+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

**READY TO DO WORK YOU'RE PROUD OF?**

Charlie Oscar isn't a typical agency. We're independent, AI-native, and built to help ambitious brands outmanoeuvre, outpace and outgrow the competition.

We blend data science with creativity - not because it's fashionable, but because it's how brands actually grow. The numbers give us clarity. The creative work is what wins hearts, builds brands, and drives revenue.

Every week here looks different: sharp strategic problems, high-calibre teammates, and real ownership over work that reaches some of the world's most ambitious brands. Outside the day job, there's run club, book and chess clubs, charity fundraisers, Thursday drinks, and enough team socials that work never feels like just work.

We hire for attitude and culture add first - not just experience. Curious, ambitious people who challenge how things are done, bring fresh ideas, and help shape the future of marketing.

Sound like your kind of place?

**WHO WE HIRE**

We look for attitude first. Smart, humble, proactive, genuinely curious - that's the shortlist. People who care about their craft without taking themselves too seriously. We build brave ideas, keep learning constant, and make sure everyone's voice counts.

If you're already using AI to work smarter, even better.  
  
**AI**

We're looking for people who use AI to sharpen their work - not replace their thinking.

You don't need to be an AI specialist. You need to be curious enough to already be finding ways to use it: faster workflows, sharper insight, better creative options, smarter decisions. We want people who ask “how can this be better?” and treat AI as a tool to elevate the craft, not a shortcut around it.

**THE ROLE**

We’re on the hunt for a Senior Influencer Campaigns Manager who can own their client’s programmes end-to-end: setting the strategy, cutting the creator deals, and proving the results in the numbers. As Senior Influencer Campaigns Manager, you'll lead delivery and performance across those accounts, reporting to the Head of Influencer, and act as each client's day-to-day strategic partner. You'll also manage and mentor junior team members and help win the new business that grows our Influencer Department.  
**WHAT YOU'LL BE GETTING STUCK INTO.**

* Own influencer strategy for your client accounts, turning brand and business objectives into clear briefs, creator strategies and measurable KPIs.
* Flawlessly Lead paid influencer campaigns end-to-end, from casting and talent negotiation through contracts, legal approvals and content sign-off to final reporting, on time and on budget.
* Negotiate creator fees, usage rights, whitelisting and paid amplification with creators and talent agents, so every deal is commercially sound.
* Run client relationships without day-to-day senior support: lead the conversations, present performance to senior stakeholders and spot ways to grow the account.
* Turn campaign data into clear recommendations, testing new approaches and optimising against performance metrics.
* Manage and mentor junior team members, setting objectives, delegating well and building their strategic, client and commercial skills.
* Shape new business pitches with creator recommendations, campaign concepts, budgets and measurement frameworks, and present them to prospective clients.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**  
  
**MUST-HAVES**

* You've owned influencer programmes at scale, from strategy to reporting, while juggling several client workstreams and budgets at once.
* You know creator market rates and deal structures well enough to negotiate with talent agents on fees, usage rights, whitelisting and paid partnerships.
* You can read performance data (CAC, ROAS, engagement, conversion) and turn it into a recommendation a senior client will act on.
* You have a sharp eye for creator-brand fit and can cast talent across categories, audiences and cultural contexts.
* You’re obsessed with pop-culture, social and content. You know what people are talking about before it becomes mainstream.
* You've managed and developed junior team members, and you take ownership of decisions without needing hand-holding.

**NICE-TO-HAVES**

# Title:  Principal RF Design Engineer

Location: 

United Kingdom, Whiteley, Hampshire, GB

**Who we are**

DTC, a Codan Company, is a leading provider of advanced communications technology supporting defence, security, broadcast, public safety, and mission-critical operations worldwide.

As part of Codan Limited, an international technology company with a long-standing reputation for delivering trusted communications solutions, DTC combines specialist engineering expertise with global resources to develop products that perform in some of the world’s most demanding operational environments.

Our technology enables the secure and reliable transmission of video, voice, and data. We work closely with customers and industry partners to address evolving operational challenges while meeting rigorous performance, quality, security, and regulatory standards.

Joining DTC offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals on advanced wireless communication technologies with a meaningful real-world impact. Employees benefit from the strength of a global organisation while contributing within a focused, agile, and collaborative engineering environment.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Principal RF Design Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team in Hampshire.

This is a hands-on engineering and technical leadership role for someone who enjoys component-level RF design and wants to contribute across the complete product lifecycle, from initial concept and detailed design through to integration, production, and in-service support.

You will take ownership of RF designs at both board and system level, developing high-performance solutions for advanced wireless communication products. You will work closely with engineers across hardware, software, mechanical, systems, test, and manufacturing disciplines to turn complex requirements into reliable, production-ready products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop RF systems and board-level hardware for advanced wireless communication products.
* Create component-level RF designs across transmitters, receivers, power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, mixers, filters, and software-defined radio systems.
* Translate product and system requirements into practical RF architectures and detailed hardware designs.
* Produce schematics, support PCB layout, and complete RF simulations and design analysis.
* Select and evaluate RF components based on performance, availability, cost, and suitability for production.
* Develop test plans and carry out hands-on verification using RF laboratory equipment.
* Support prototype bring-up, system integration, troubleshooting, validation, and qualification.
* Analyse RF performance, identify design issues, and implement effective technical solutions.
* Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure RF designs integrate successfully with the wider product.
* Support manufacturing, including design transfer, production testing, fault investigation, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to design reviews, technical documentation, risk management, and engineering best practices.
* Provide technical support for products throughout their operational lifecycle.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* A degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong commercial experience in discrete, component-level RF design.
* Strong RF design and analysis capability at both board and system level.
* A solid understanding of RF principles, including impedance matching, noise, linearity, gain, stability, filtering, and signal integrity.
* Experience developing RF hardware from initial concept through to test, validation, and production.
* Experience designing RF circuits such as transmitters, receivers, amplifiers, mixers, oscillators, and filters.
* Proficiency with RF simulation and electronic design automation tools such as AWR, PADS, or comparable packages.
* Hands-on experience using RF laboratory equipment, including network analysers, spectrum analysers, signal generators, power meters, and oscilloscopes.
* The ability to interpret requirements, make sound engineering decisions, and resolve complex technical problems.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers from different technical disciplines.
* Eligibility to obtain UK Security Check clearance.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience developing software-defined radio products or other advanced wireless communication systems.
* Knowledge of RF propagation, modulation techniques, communication system architectures, and link budgets.
* Experience designing transceivers, low-noise amplifiers, power amplifiers, mixers, and RF filter networks.
* Familiarity with electromagnetic compatibility requirements, testing, and compliance.
* Experience supporting PCB layout for RF and mixed-signal designs.
* Exposure to digital signal processing or embedded communication systems.
* Experience working with manufacturing teams and supporting products through production and in-service operation.
* Experience within defence, public safety, broadcast, or another highly regulated or mission-critical environment.

**Why join DTC**

* Work on advanced RF technology used in demanding environments around the world.
* Take ownership of designs throughout the complete engineering lifecycle.
* Collaborate with experienced specialists across a range of engineering disciplines.
* Contribute to products that support defence, public safety, broadcast, and mission-critical operations.
* Benefit from flexible working, a strong benefits package, and ongoing professional development.
* Join a focused and agile engineering business backed by the resources and international reach of the Codan Group.

**Apply**

If you are passionate about hands-on RF design and want to develop technology that performs when reliable communication matters most, we would be pleased to hear from you.

**About the Role**

As a Warden, you’ll play a key role in managing, enhancing and protecting the ecological value and historic features of The Leasowes, while ensuring it remains a welcoming and safe space for visitors. You’ll work closely with volunteers, community groups, schools, and contractors to deliver practical conservation, education, and engagement activities.

## Job Description

**The Role**  
CSL is looking for a Principal Programmer to take technical ownership of statistical programming across a compound or programme, not just a single study. You’ll be the person who sets how the programming gets done across multiple trials and through to submission, and the one a study team, a CRO or a regulator’s question ultimately lands with. This is still a hands-on role, and you’ll write and validate code when the work calls for it. Most of your impact, though, comes from the decisions upstream: how standards are applied across studies so an integrated analysis comes together cleanly, how CRO work is scoped and held to account, and how a submission package is built so it holds up under review. You’ll work as a peer to biostatistics, data management, medical writing and regulatory leads, and you’ll be in the room early enough to shape a programme’s analysis strategy rather than inherit it.

  

***Hybrid Based (3 days a week onsite) in Maidenhead***

  

**Why It Matters**  
A single well-programmed study is valuable. A programme where every study was built to the same standard, so pooled safety and efficacy analyses come together without months of rework, is what gets a submission over the line. This role sits at that level. You spot the inconsistency between two studies’ ADaM conventions before it becomes an ISS problem, push back on a CRO deliverable that technically meets spec but won’t survive a reviewer, and make the call on the trade-offs between speed, consistency and regulatory defensibility. When an agency query comes back, you’re the one who knows why the data was built the way it was.

  

**What You’ll Be Responsible For**  
You’ll lead programming at the programme or compound level, across in-house and outsourced studies, from study setup through integrated analyses and regulatory submission. You’ll set direction for other programmers, internal and external, and help shape how the wider programming function works.

* Serve as lead programmer for a compound or programme, overseeing programming across multiple clinical trials and ensuring consistency of standards and approach
* Lead the planning, specification and delivery of integrated analyses (ISS/ISE) and pooled datasets, and own the submission-ready data package, including define.xml, reviewer guides (cSDRG/ADRG) and conformance checks
* Define programming strategy for outsourced studies, set expectations for CROs and hold their deliverables to submission standard
* Act as the programming point of contact for regulatory submissions and agency queries, working with biostatistics and regulatory colleagues on responses
* Lead and mentor other programmers, providing technical direction, review and day-to-day guidance across the programme
* Contribute to departmental standards, macros, tools and process improvement, including the adoption of new approaches such as R-based workflows
* Take on hands-on programming and ad hoc analytical work (exploratory analyses, publication support, regulatory responses) as the programme requires

  

**Experience Required**

* Substantial statistical programming experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO or clinical research settings, including lead programmer responsibility across multiple studies

# Revenue Operations Manager

London, UK

## About Dwelly

Dwelly is building the AI operating system for residential lettings. Its growing network of agencies provides its AI with real-world data, continuous feedback, and control over complete workflows, making exceptional service the standard for landlords and tenants. Today, Dwelly operates more than 15,000 properties and $470 million in GMV, making it one of the UK’s ten largest lettings operators. The company has raised $263 million.  
  
We’re a fast-growing, product-focused company, backed by top-tier investors and led by a team with deep experience in real estate, technology, and operations.

## 

## Position Summary

The Revenue Operations Manager builds the commercial operating system behind Dwelly’s growth. This is the first RevOps hire in the UK and a senior role: you will own the numbers, the systems, the pricing, and the incentives that the entire commercial organisation runs on — and you will build a small team to do it.

The UK GM / Commercial Director owns the relationships and the outcome. You own the machine that makes the outcome predictable: one source of truth on portfolio, revenue and margin by agency and branch; a pricing and fee realisation engine that closes the gap between what we should charge and what we actually collect; a landlord CRM that is clean enough to run a business on; and a target and incentive structure that points every Area Director, Branch Leader / MD, and Valuer at the same number.

Your targets are the company’s: +10% portfolio growth and +20% revenue growth year-on-year. You will be measured on results within the first 3–6 months, so this role suits someone who balances rigorous, data-driven thinking with a “get things done” attitude.

We are scaling from ~20,000 properties today to 50,000–70,000 within 12 months and ~200,000 in the following 12–24 months, largely through acquisition. Every agency we buy arrives with its own fee structures, its own data, its own spreadsheets and its own definition of a “landlord”. Turning that into one commercial system — repeatably, on a two-month integration clock — is the core of this job.

## 

## Key Responsibilities

**1. Commercial Reporting, Forecasting & Operating Cadence**

* Own the single source of truth on portfolio, revenue, and profit contribution — by agency, branch, MD, and landlord segment — and make it the number the business argues from.
* Define the commercial metric tree from top-line targets down to what a Valuer does on a Tuesday, so that every layer of the org is measured on something it can actually move.
* Run the weekly and monthly commercial cadence for the GM: forecast vs. plan, variance analysis, early warning on agencies drifting off trajectory, and the decisions each review needs to produce.
* Build the reporting that surfaces the drivers behind the number — churn by cause, fee leakage, attach rates, rent review execution — not just the number itself.

**2. Pricing, Fee Realisation & Ancillary Revenue**

* Own fee realisation across acquired portfolios: quantify the gap between standard and actual fees, harmonise inconsistent and legacy-discounted structures, and drive the migration agency by agency without triggering churn.
* Make recurring revenue levers fire reliably across the whole portfolio — annual rent reviews above all — with tracked coverage, timing, and uplift rather than best efforts.
* Grow the underdeveloped ancillary line (rent guarantees, zero deposit, unified deposit schemes, contractor commissions, mortgage and other financial products) by owning attach rate targets, pricing, partner commercial terms, and the operational path to sell them.
* Build the pricing governance: who can discount, by how much, with what approval, and what it costs us — and hold the line.

**3. Commercial Systems & CRM Operations**

* Own the usage of the landlord CRM: pipeline stages, data model, hygiene standards, workflow automation, and adoption across a distributed MD and Valuer org.
* Own commercial data quality end-to-end — landlord, property, fee, and tenancy data — and the reconciliation between CRM, the platform, and finance. If the numbers disagree, it is your job to make them agree.
* Partner closely with the Growth Product Manager: they own what we build for landlords, you own how the commercial org runs on it. Translate field reality into product requirements, and product releases into adoption on the ground.
* Select, implement, and administer the supporting commercial stack (BI, CRM, enablement, comp tooling) with a strong bias toward fewer tools used properly.

**4. Targets, Incentives & Performance Management**

* Design the target-setting model: how portfolio and revenue targets are set per agency and branch, normalised for portfolio quality, local market, and acquisition timing.
* Design and administer commission and bonus plans for the MD, Branch Leader and Valuer org — aligned to growth, retention, and profit contribution, and deliberately free of conflicting incentives.
* Own territory and portfolio allocation, capacity modelling, and the analysis of what good actually looks like at each level.
* Build the performance management layer: league tables, coaching inputs, and the evidence base for where to invest, intervene, or exit.

**5. Commercial Integration of Acquired Agencies**

* Build the repeatable commercial integration playbook: what we measure from day one, how fee and landlord data is migrated and cleansed, when the agency joins the standard cadence, and what "integrated" means as a checklist.
* Support diligence and the first 100 days with the revenue analytics that tell us what we bought — fee quality, concentration, churn exposure, and the realistic uplift case.
* Work with the GM to sequence pricing and process change across newly acquired portfolios so that value capture does not cost us the portfolio.

## 

## Qualifications & Preferred Background

* **Experience:** 5–7 years in revenue operations, commercial operations, sales operations, or strategy & operations, including time in a fast-scaling, target-carrying commercial environment. Experience building a function from scratch rather than inheriting one
* **Skills:** Genuinely strong analytics — SQL and BI tooling as a working habit, financial modelling, comfort owning a forecast in front of a board. Deep, hands-on CRM ownership. Commission and incentive plan design
* Exceptional people skills: this role only works if a distributed org of MDs, Branch Leaders and Valuers actually adopts what you build. You will spend real time in branches, not only in dashboards
* Highly commercial acumen — comfortable owning revenue and margin outcomes, not just reporting on them
* In step with recent technology advancements: can build meaningful analysis, automation and internal tooling independently with the help of AI
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with a “get things done” attitude and excellent attention to detail

**Preferred background**

* Experience in multi-site, branch-network, or franchise businesses — where the commercial org is distributed and local relationships carry the revenue
* Experience in a PE-backed roll-up or high-velocity M&A environment, including commercial integration of acquired businesses
* Exposure to financial services / fintech attach products (insurance, guarantees, lending, payments) is a strong plus

## 

## Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary with the potential for equity options based on stellar performance.

### 

## **What is it like being a Dwell-er**

Feel free to check out Dwelly Core Principles. That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.

What we offer is not a fancy office or a static workplace. Instead, this is solving one of worlds’ most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world (residential rentals), to improve the experience for >30% of households (>5M in the UK, and >100M including EU and US) that live in rental homes.

This is about disrupting the largest, most antiquated industry in the world, with one of the strongest operational and technical teams that exist in the UK and the EU. We work hard, and we shoot for extremely ambitious results. But we want people to be proud of what they’ve built and be able to look back and say one day “hell yeah, that was me that did it all”.

* **Customer obsession rather than competitive focus**
* **Passion for invention**
* **Operational excellence**
* **Long-term thinking**

Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our **CTO, Michael Monin** and our **Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol**. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

## **Key Responsibilities**

* **Safety & legal product strategy and delivery.** Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.
* **Internally developed moderation technologies**. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. * **Third-party safety partnerships and integrations**. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.
* **Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance**. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.
* **Red teaming and adversarial testing**. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.
* **Trust and safety reviews for new features**. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.
* **Incident follow-through and continuous improvement**. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

* **Content moderation and AI guardrails**: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.
* **Legal/safety work experience**: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;
* **Collaborative mindset and communication**: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;
* **AI fluency:** You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;
* **You are point person for third-party partnerships:** You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;
* **You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty:** Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;
* **You are comfortable with the product category:** you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

The Apollo programme is replacing the many separate tools used at each sales stage with one operating model. In the Proposing stage, that means one new proposal platform that produces a single, standard customer business case. It replaces the self-service tools that today give different answers for the same customer scenario.

The Proposal Tools Analyst lays the groundwork that makes this possible. You will work through the existing business case, TCO, RFX and proposal tools. You'll turn what you learn into one prioritised, traceable set of requirements. Then you'll make sure each old tool is retired safely.

The role has three parts:

* **Understand the estate.** Work with each tool owner to document what their tool does, what data it relies on, who uses it and why.
* **Define the platform.** Turn that understanding into one set of system requirements that the build team works and tests against.
* **Retire safely.** Switch off each old tool only once the new platform has been shown to cover what the field needs from it.

## **What Success Looks Like**

* Every proposal, business case and RFP tool in GSO is known to the programme. Each in-scope tool has a full document that its owner has checked.
* There is one requirements catalogue, kept in sync with the prototype. Every requirement traces back to the field need and the tool it came from.
* Requirements are prioritised with the Field Advisory Group and Proposal Track leads, so the build team works from one ranked list.
* Testing covers the documented requirements, and the Field Advisory Group has formally signed it off.
* Tools are retired on schedule without disrupting the field. Each retirement is signed off against a capability map, not a date.
* There is an agreed recommendation for RFP and RFQ tooling.

### **Discovery**

* Build on the Apollo dashboard inventory with a detailed document for each tool: scope, functions, users, data, calculation logic, outputs and limits.
* Find tools that aren't recorded yet and get them submitted to the programme.
* Trace each tool's data sources, assumptions and hard-coded values. Flag overlaps, gaps and places where tools give different financial outputs.

### **Requirements and Product Partnership**

* Turn field needs and tool functions into clear, testable requirements, and feed them into the prototype as it changes.
* Decide what to rebuild, retire or combine, and record why.
* Work with Global Value Management to document TCO, cash flow and P&L requirements. Capture non-functional needs too, such as Salesforce write-back, governance, permissions and auditability.
* Work with the Business Platform Owner and DTG as the business-side counterpart. Help shape releases that let old tools be retired as early as possible.

### **Testing and Decommissioning**

* Make sure test scope and test cases map directly to the requirements. Take completed testing to the Field Advisory Group for sign-off.
* Own the capability map that links each old tool to the requirements that must be delivered before it can be switched off.
* Set exit criteria and transition paths with tool owners, and give Sales Enablement what they need for cutover training.
* Capture logic and content worth keeping before a tool is switched off.

### **RFP Tooling**

* Review how the field uses Responsive today and gather RFP and RFQ requirements.
* Compare Responsive with the alternatives, including building RFP responses into the new platform. Recommend an approach with cost, effort and timeline.

* Lead portfolio capacity planning, maintaining visibility of demand, resource utilisation and delivery constraints.
* Support quarterly and annual planning cycles with robust analysis and prioritisation recommendations.
* Produce governance reporting, monitor delivery against approved arguments and provide actionable portfolio insights.

* Experience working within complex, matrixed organisations.

* Ability to translate strategic objectives into practical prioritisation frameworks and governance processes.
* Strong analytical skills with a data-driven approach to decision-making.

# Network Architect (we have office locations in Cambridge, Leeds and London)

* Full-time
* Department: Technology & Architecture
* Office: London

## Company Description

Genomics England is a global leader in enabling genomic medicine and research, focused on creating a world where everyone benefits from genomic healthcare. Building on the 100,000 Genomes Project, we support the NHS’s world-first national whole genome sequencing service and run the growing National Genomic Research Library, alongside delivering numerous major genomics initiatives. By connecting research and clinical care at national scale, we enable immediate healthcare benefits and advances for the future.

Our mission is to provide the evidence and digital systems so that by 2035 genomics could play a role in up to half of all healthcare interactions, whilst securing the UK’s position as the best place to discover, prove and benefit from genomic innovations.

We are accelerating our impact and working with patients, doctors, scientists, government and industry to improve genomic testing, and help researchers access the health data and technology they need to make new medical discoveries and create more effective, targeted medicines for everybody.

Behind the Healthcare and Research outcomes, Genomics England delivers through designing, developing and operating complex healthcare software systems.

We're on the cusp of big changes with the real prospect of genomics becoming the fabric of everyday healthcare through the lifetime – from birth to old age.

## Job Description

**Network Architect**

We’re looking for an accomplished Network Architect to join our Scalable Tech Team at Genomics England and provide technical leadership for the secure, resilient connectivity that underpins our technology platform, healthcare, research and corporate services.

Our network services connect cloud platforms (primarily AWS) and on-premise infrastructure, enabling clinicians, researchers and colleagues to access sensitive genomic and associated health data securely and reliably.

Working within the Technology and Product Directorate, you’ll shape and deliver Genomics England’s network architecture across AWS, hybrid connectivity, corporate locations and partner integrations. You’ll collaborate with infrastructure, cloud platform, security, engineering, procurement, commercial, service management and delivery colleagues to turn complex operational and user needs into coherent, cost-effective, scalable and secure network solutions.

This is an architecture role where you’ll balance longer-term network strategy with practical delivery, using your proven experience and expertise. You will guide teams through network architecture decisions, develop reusable standards and patterns, and ensure solutions align with Genomics England’s wider technology strategy, architecture standards, security requirements and service expectations.

The scale and sensitivity of genomics require high-performing, highly available networks. AWS is at the heart of our environment, alongside hybrid and third-party connectivity, supporting secure data transfer, high-performance compute, large-scale storage, research workflows, operational services and controlled access to sensitive data.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture and design of network solutions across Genomics England, ensuring they are secure, scalable, cost-effective, resilient, supportable and aligned with organisational needs. Define target architectures, standards and reusable patterns for cloud, hybrid, remote-access and partner connectivity.
* Design and govern AWS networking, including multi-account connectivity, VPC design, routing, segmentation, private connectivity, DNS, load balancing and network security controls. Architect resilient connectivity between AWS, Genomics England locations, NHS and government partners, research organisations, suppliers and other trusted environments.
* Work with security colleagues to embed zero-trust principles, least privilege, network segmentation, secure remote access, encryption in transit and effective boundary protection. Ensure network designs support the secure movement and processing of large-scale genomic and associated health data, including high-throughput and latency-sensitive workloads.
* Develop network roadmaps and transition architectures that balance strategic direction, technical debt, service continuity and delivery priorities. Provide architectural oversight from discovery and options analysis through implementation, migration and live service.
* Document network architectures, traffic flows, trust boundaries, technical options, decisions, dependencies and transition states clearly for technical and non-technical audiences. Define requirements for network observability, performance monitoring, capacity management, configuration control, resilience testing and incident response.
* Collaborate with cloud platform, infrastructure, engineering, security, service management and delivery teams to ensure designs can be implemented and operated effectively. Contribute to architecture governance and assurance, presenting network designs and recommendations through appropriate technical forums.
* Identify network risks, constraints, dependencies and single points of failure early, working with teams to address them. Evaluate emerging networking technologies and managed services where they could improve security, performance, resilience, operability or cost-effectiveness.
* Work with architects across Genomics England to create coherent end-to-end solutions and encourage appropriate reuse across services. Contribute to architecture best practice and improving the quality of architecture across Genomics England.

**Skills and Experience for Success**

* Substantial experience designing and delivering enterprise network architectures in complex, security-conscious environments, with strong knowledge of AWS networking services and patterns, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPN, Route 53, load balancing, private endpoints and network security controls.
* Experience designing hybrid and multi-site connectivity, routing, switching, segmentation, firewalls, DNS, IP address management, load balancing and secure remote access. Detailed knowledge of physical network technology, ideally Cisco, NVIDIA and Mellanox, and in-depth understanding of Cisco Nexus Dashboard, data centre fabrics, Aruba networking infrastructure, BGP, OSPF, RoCE v2, performance optimisation and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting highly available and resilient networks with clear recovery objectives, diverse connectivity and tested failover arrangements. Strong understanding of network security architecture, zero-trust principles, defence in depth, trust boundaries and secure connectivity to third parties.
* Experience designing networks for high-throughput, data-intensive or latency-sensitive workloads and diagnosing performance or capacity constraints. Good understanding of automation, infrastructure as code, configuration management, observability and operational support for modern networks.
* Ability to translate business, security, operational and user needs into practical network designs, standards and delivery roadmaps, balancing strategic architectural direction with immediate delivery needs, legacy constraints and service continuity.
* Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and building alignment across architecture, infrastructure, cloud, engineering, security, procurement, commercial, service management and delivery stakeholders. Strong stakeholder engagement and a collaborative approach that builds trust and supports effective decision-making.
* Experience documenting and communicating network architectures, traffic flows, options, risks and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, and providing architectural governance and assurance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Ability to identify where network architecture practices, standards or controls could be improved and to embed those improvements into regular use.

**Desirable Skills and Experience**

* Relevant professional certification, such as AWS Advanced Networking, AWS Solutions Architect, Cisco CCNP/CCIE or an equivalent qualification.
* Experience working in healthcare, genomics, research, government or another regulated environment handling sensitive data, and experience in procurement processes associated with network infrastructure in a UK government organisation.
* Experience with software-defined networking, SD-WAN, secure access service edge, network access control or zero-trust network access. Knowledge of AWS Network Firewall, Cloud WAN, VPC Lattice, Gateway Load Balancer and related network security or connectivity services.
* Experience designing connectivity for high-performance compute, large-scale storage, data transfer appliances or distributed data-processing environments, and integrating with NHS, government, academic, research or commercial partner networks.
* Knowledge of network telemetry and tooling, including flow logs, packet analysis, synthetic monitoring, performance analytics and security monitoring.
* Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, automation and policy as code for network services.
* Understanding of identity-aware networking, certificate services, encryption, proxies, web gateways and data-loss prevention controls.
* Experience contributing to architecture governance forums such as a Technical Design Authority, familiarity with enterprise architecture tools such as Abacus, and experience applying TOGAF or equivalent architecture practices.

If you’re an experienced Network Architect who enjoys solving complex connectivity and security challenges, this is an exciting opportunity to shape the secure, resilient networks spanning AWS, on-premises infrastructure and partner environments that support life-changing genomic healthcare and research at Genomics England.

We aim to remove barriers in our recruitment processes and to be flexible with our interview processes. Should you require any adjustments that may help you to fully participate in the recruitment process, we encourage you to discuss this with us.

## Job Description

**Network Architect**

We’re looking for an accomplished Network Architect to join our Scalable Tech Team at Genomics England and provide technical leadership for the secure, resilient connectivity that underpins our technology platform, healthcare, research and corporate services.

Our network services connect cloud platforms (primarily AWS) and on-premise infrastructure, enabling clinicians, researchers and colleagues to access sensitive genomic and associated health data securely and reliably.

Working within the Technology and Product Directorate, you’ll shape and deliver Genomics England’s network architecture across AWS, hybrid connectivity, corporate locations and partner integrations. You’ll collaborate with infrastructure, cloud platform, security, engineering, procurement, commercial, service management and delivery colleagues to turn complex operational and user needs into coherent, cost-effective, scalable and secure network solutions.

This is an architecture role where you’ll balance longer-term network strategy with practical delivery, using your proven experience and expertise. You will guide teams through network architecture decisions, develop reusable standards and patterns, and ensure solutions align with Genomics England’s wider technology strategy, architecture standards, security requirements and service expectations.

The scale and sensitivity of genomics require high-performing, highly available networks. AWS is at the heart of our environment, alongside hybrid and third-party connectivity, supporting secure data transfer, high-performance compute, large-scale storage, research workflows, operational services and controlled access to sensitive data.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture and design of network solutions across Genomics England, ensuring they are secure, scalable, cost-effective, resilient, supportable and aligned with organisational needs. Define target architectures, standards and reusable patterns for cloud, hybrid, remote-access and partner connectivity.
* Design and govern AWS networking, including multi-account connectivity, VPC design, routing, segmentation, private connectivity, DNS, load balancing and network security controls. Architect resilient connectivity between AWS, Genomics England locations, NHS and government partners, research organisations, suppliers and other trusted environments.
* Work with security colleagues to embed zero-trust principles, least privilege, network segmentation, secure remote access, encryption in transit and effective boundary protection. Ensure network designs support the secure movement and processing of large-scale genomic and associated health data, including high-throughput and latency-sensitive workloads.
* Develop network roadmaps and transition architectures that balance strategic direction, technical debt, service continuity and delivery priorities. Provide architectural oversight from discovery and options analysis through implementation, migration and live service.
* Document network architectures, traffic flows, trust boundaries, technical options, decisions, dependencies and transition states clearly for technical and non-technical audiences. Define requirements for network observability, performance monitoring, capacity management, configuration control, resilience testing and incident response.
* Collaborate with cloud platform, infrastructure, engineering, security, service management and delivery teams to ensure designs can be implemented and operated effectively. Contribute to architecture governance and assurance, presenting network designs and recommendations through appropriate technical forums.
* Identify network risks, constraints, dependencies and single points of failure early, working with teams to address them. Evaluate emerging networking technologies and managed services where they could improve security, performance, resilience, operability or cost-effectiveness.
* Work with architects across Genomics England to create coherent end-to-end solutions and encourage appropriate reuse across services. Contribute to architecture best practice and improving the quality of architecture across Genomics England.

**Skills and Experience for Success**

* Substantial experience designing and delivering enterprise network architectures in complex, security-conscious environments, with strong knowledge of AWS networking services and patterns, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPN, Route 53, load balancing, private endpoints and network security controls.

Experience

* Monitor campaign performance metrics and present regular performance updates and insight, highlighting successes, areas for improvement, and actionable insights. Utilize data-driven insights to continuously optimize marketing campaigns for maximum ROI and performance. Drive a culture of continuous improvement, promoting a test and learn approach to ensure we are at the forefront of acquisition opportunities.
* Champion a data-driven test-and-learn approach to optimise customer acquisition, retention, and media efficiency.
* Build capabilities in audience targeting, first-party data activation, and lifecycle marketing to improve retention and LTV.

* Build and lead a team of specialists across CRM, Amazon Retail Media, Performance Media, - providing guidance, mentorship, and professional development opportunities. Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning within the team. Set clear goals and performance expectations for team members and conduct regular performance reviews.

* Strong track record in search marketing and managing retail media on marketplaces like Amazon.
* Expertise in customer acquisition channels including Social and CRM
* Proven ability to lead cross-channel strategies that drive measurable growth in D2C and marketplace revenue.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, with experience building, managing and developing teams.
* Experience managing multi-million-pound media budgets across European markets.
* Proficiency in analytics platforms (e.g., GA4, Looker/Power BI, Data Studio) and ad tech (Google Ads, Amazon DSP, programmatic platforms).

* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional teams.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute innovative marketing strategies that drive business results.

The opportunity will be based in ***London*** with hybrid working arrangements available which offer you a greater choice in how you work and live, giving you a better work-life balance.  

  

**What we would like to offer you!**  

The opportunity to develop your career on a global stage, continuous learning through an on-demand learning platform, and a competitive compensation package including staff discounts, generous family leave policy, health & dental plan and competitive salary.

Glanbia is a better nutrition company with three divisions: Performance Nutrition, Health & Nutrition and Dairy Nutrition. **We’re Heidi.**

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

## **The role**

We’re looking for a doctor who has moved into AI and can code, to join Clinical AI R&D as a Clinical AI Engineer. You’ll sit inside a product pod and own the evidence for its product: define the evaluation before anyone builds, run it to a standard a journal reviewer would accept, keep watching the product once it ships, publish what the evidence shows, and change the product when the evidence says to.

The pod’s engineers can change the product but can’t judge whether a discharge summary missed something a consultant would catch. Clinicians can make that call but can’t open a pull request. You do both, and you treat the gap between a model’s output and good clinical practice as the thing you’re here to measure and close.

The loop doesn’t end at launch. You stay with the product for its life in market.

**What you’ll do**

* **Design the evaluation.** Define evaluations for greenfield products to an academic standard: endpoints, comparators, ground truth, sample size, analysis plan. Set the bar before the result arrives.
* **Build the measurement.** Build, optimize and validate the LLM judges and rubrics that score the product at scale. Report their agreement with clinician ground truth, not their convenience, and retire the ones that drift.
* **Run it and write it up.** Execute the evaluation, do the statistics, and write it up once in a form that serves the pod, the regulatory file and an academic submission.
* **Run post-market surveillance.** Monitor output quality in production and respond to regulatory feedback with data. Our clinical safety team triages complaints and incidents; you’re their counterpart in the pod, working out what their findings mean for the product and what should change.
* **Fix what the evidence finds.** Prompt and rubric changes, evaluation harness changes, code changes in the pod’s codebase, shipped through the pod’s normal review and release process.
* **Publish.** Contribute to peer-reviewed literature on the translational benefit of the product.
* **Be the clinician in the room.** Catch the output that reads well and is wrong. Hold the line on clinical nuance when a shortcut would ship faster.

**What you'll need**

* **A medical degree and clinical practice** with independent clinical judgment. This role runs on medical nuance, and this requirement doesn’t flex.
* **Academic depth.** Study design, inferential statistics, agreement and reliability measures, sample size, handling of multiple comparisons. Thesis or publication-level work, not a methods module.
* **Experience evaluating medical software or clinical AI,** including building or validating LLM-as-judge pipelines.
* **Enough engineering to work in a production codebase.** Read it, understand what a change will do, make the change in Python or TypeScript, and get it through review. Prompt engineering and AI-assisted coding are daily tools here, and they’re the floor, not the ceiling.
* **Independence.** You can run a project for weeks with light direction, and you say early when it’s stuck.
* **Clear writing.** Evaluation reports, surveillance summaries and manuscripts are the primary output of this role.

**Nice to have**

* Post-market surveillance or vigilance work under a medical device framework (TGA, MHRA, FDA or EU MDR). Appetite to learn counts for more than existing depth.
* Peer-reviewed publications on clinical AI or LLM evaluation.
* Machine learning background beyond prompting, such as fine-tuning or classical model evaluation.
* Specialty depth in an area Heidi is moving into.
* An academic or clinical-site network able to host a study.

**How we show up**

* **Build for the next decade, not next quarter**. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.
* **Lead, don't wait**. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.
* **Follow the evidence**. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.
* **Own the outcome**. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.
* **Ship, measure, go again**. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.
* **Live in clinicians' reality**. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

**Why Heidi?**

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

**Our Benefits**

* **Equity from day one.** When Heidi wins, you win. You'll share directly in the success you help create.
* **Your health, covered.** Comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, plus 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder and a £100/month Healthy Heidi’s stipend.
* **Global parental leave**. 26 weeks paid for primary carers and 18 weeks for secondary carers, subject to eligibility.
* **Fertility support**. £7,000 one-off payment, eligibility applies.
* **Learning & development.** £700 per year for courses, books, memberships, conferences and more.
* **Home office budget** of £500 one-off to set up a workspace you actually want to work in.
* **Recharge days** after major milestones and busy periods so you can reset and come back strong.
* **Work from anywhere** for up to 4 weeks per year, wherever the world takes you.
* **Clinical leave**. 10 days per year for eligible clinical roles to maintain accreditation and requirements.
* **Flexibility that works.** A hybrid environment, with 3 days in the office.

# Operations Performance Analyst

## The Operations Performance Analyst drives operational effectiveness through data analysis, performance improvement and business change.

Looking for a challenge in one of the world’s largest airfreight logistics organisations?

At IAG Cargo we are in the business of moving things. From antibiotics to groundbreaking tech, gold bullion to avocados and everything in between. We move cargo that positively impacts society worldwide. Whatever people need, wherever they are. At IAG Cargo we open the skies and fly the world to bring people the things they really need.  

We are the logistics and cargo brand of International Airlines Group (Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia, Level and Vueling). Powered by five airlines, our reach is truly global – but it’s the impact we make that defines us. At IAG Cargo, we believe in keeping the world’s economies turning, and do everything with determined attitudes, curious minds, collaborative actions and heartfelt pride. Join us at our globally recognised logistics business, that is Trusted to Deliver.

#### **About the role**

The Operations Performance Analyst is a key driver of operational effectiveness across Worldwide Operations, combining analytical expertise with hands-on support for performance improvement and business change initiatives. The role works closely with operational teams to deliver meaningful performance insights, identify and quantify the impact of operational disruptions, strategic initiatives and improvement projects on key business KPIs, and support data-driven decision making. The Operations Performance Analyst is responsible for ensuring timely, accurate and actionable data is available to support operational delivery, developing performance metrics and reporting, and translating insight into practical actions that drive measurable improvements in performance, cost, customer experience and productivity. The role also leads or supports operational improvement projects, works with stakeholders across the business to realise benefits, and provides near real-time and historical performance insight to support continuous improvement and delivery of the Worldwide Operations strategy

#### **What you’ll do**

* Work with all Worldwide Operations teams to agree and deliver an appropriate suite of operational metrics underpinning performance, cost, customer experience and employee targets.
* Ensure accurate, timely and relevant data and insight is provided to continuously improve operational performance (including KPIs, SLAs, and productivity metrics).
* Analyse performance data trends and conduct root cause analysis to identify prioritised opportunities for improvement.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities for performance improvement.
* Develop and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility into operational performance.
* Drive improvements through more efficient reporting using automation.
* Identify gaps in data availability and propose practical solutions.
* Partner with operational teams to develop, implement and track performance improvement initiatives, ensuring actions are delivered and benefits realised.
* Scope and lead or support improvement projects as required.
* Provide hands-on support to operational and strategic projects, helping to identify issues, coordinate actions and drive delivery of business objectives.
* Contribute to the definition, elaboration, communication and implementation of the Worldwide Operations strategy, taking into account trends, technology and business data.
* Represent Worldwide Operations across IAG Cargo to ensure operational data requirements are clear and delivered.
* Act as the interface between Worldwide Operations and the IAG Cargo Data & Analytics teams to support provision and validation of data, metric development and data visualisation.
* Ensure adherence to the governance structure for regular review of operational performance across all areas.
* Contribute to the provision of reporting on performance data to the IAG Cargo Executive Team via weekly and monthly packs and narratives and contribute to business reviews.
* Analyse and quantify the impact of operational disruptions, business initiatives and improvement projects on key performance indicators, using data-driven insight and scenario analysis to support decision making and prioritisation.

#### **It's all about you**

What you’ll bring to IAG Cargo:

We are looking for a strategic thinker with an investigative mindset, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate insight into action. We are not necessarily looking for deep expertise in any particular analytical tools. What we are looking for is someone who can learn new tools quickly, enjoys investigating complex operational issues with a calm and methodical approach, can assess data quality and business impact, and is able to deliver value through practical, incremental improvements. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and have the resourcefulness and curiosity to uncover solutions, influence stakeholders and drive positive outcomes, even when the tools are not yet perfect and the data is incomplete.

You should have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and operational teams alike. Experience in performance analysis, business improvement, project delivery or operational problem-solving is essential, ideally within transportation, logistics, supply chain or transformation environments. You should be collaborative, proactive and comfortable working hands-on with teams across the business to identify opportunities, support decision making, implement improvements and deliver measurable operational benefits.

Skills and Experience:

* Hold a 2:1 degree or above (or equivalent) in Data Analytics, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.
* Have relevant experience in data or business analysis.
* Have proficiency in MS Office (particularly Excel), SQL and BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau).
* Have the right to live and work full-time in the UK indefinitely.
* Be able to pass a Criminal Record Check.

It would be helpful, but not essential to have:

* Experience with Lean, Six Sigma or other process improvement methodologies.
* Knowledge of Python as well as AI application to data analysis.
* Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Snowflake).
* Background in air cargo or complex operational environments.

#### We’ll treat you right

Wherever you work within IAG Cargo, you’ll play a part in helping us deliver what the world needs and join a diverse and inclusive business that’s making a difference.

As well as a competitive salary, bonus, we offer a range of benefits to support our colleagues, which include:

* A hybrid environment with 3 days a week in the office and two from home.
* From the day you join us, you’ll get access to brilliant staff travel benefits including unlimited basic and premium standby tickets on British Airways and group airlines. You’ll also receive up to 30 discounted ‘Hotline’ airfares per year for yourself, friends, and family.
* Flexible bank holiday policy- Individuals not on shift have the flexibility to swap the statutory public holidays, with the days you choose to take off instead.
* All our colleagues get access to LinkedIn learning and Rosetta Stone Language courses
* For health and wellbeing we offer a free onsite gym facility as well as access to the UNMIND app and a community of Mental Health First Aiders
* Access to discounts on Apple, Cinema tickets and loads of other goodies through Perks at work

**Diversity and Inclusion**

Our recruitment procedures positively support our diversity and inclusion agenda.

All candidates are considered strictly on their merits in relation to the criteria for the role, treated fairly and consistently, and have their individual needs responded to throughout the process.
