**Who We Are:**

IMG is a leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 250 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the AELTC (Wimbledon), Euroleague Basketball, CONMEBOL, World Rugby, DP World Tour, and The R&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR. IMG is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company.
TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

  

* Own the design development of commercial partnership proposals, RFPs, sales presentations, category decks, case studies, post-event reports, templates and other partnership marketing materials.
* Translate complex commercial strategies, audience insights, rights packages, data and activation ideas into clear, persuasive visual narratives with strong hierarchy and editorial quality.
* Develop creative routes, cover options, visual territories, page layouts and design systems that give each proposal a distinctive point of view while remaining practical to deliver.
* Work through the full Marketing Solutions process: interpret the brief, support content development, lead creative development, review and refine drafts, and deliver final editable and presentation-ready files.
* Collaborate with Brand Partnerships, sales, strategy, project management, research, rights-holder and client teams to understand the brief, identify the commercial story and guide the visual direction.
* Set and maintain high standards for grid, typography, spacing, image selection, colour, lock-ups, logo visibility, data visualisation, motion and overall information density across every deliverable.
* Protect the clarity and consistency of the deck or campaign while responding constructively to feedback, distinguishing between essential content changes and design decisions that affect hierarchy, flow and legibility.
* Use PowerPoint, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite and other relevant tools to create polished, flexible and easy-to-edit outputs; support motion, video and interactive elements where they strengthen the story.
* Help evolve team templates, toolkits, workflows and ways of working so that the team can deliver consistent, high-quality work efficiently across regions and categories.
* Share design knowledge, give thoughtful feedback and support the development of other designers and project teams without losing ownership of your own work.
* Use AI and emerging creative technologies responsibly to accelerate exploration, improve storytelling and increase efficiency while retaining human judgement and craft.
* Manage multiple projects and priorities across a global team, remaining organised, calm and detail-focused while working to tight pitch, client and submission deadlines.
* Present and explain creative thinking confidently, internally and externally, using design rationale to help stakeholders make informed decisions.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* 6+ years’ experience in presentation design, graphic design, brand design or creative communications, ideally within sport, entertainment, agency, sponsorship, media or commercial marketing environments.
* A strong portfolio showing high-quality commercial presentations, pitch design, editorial storytelling, brand systems, data-led communications and/or partnership marketing work.
* Experience turning business or marketing strategy into visual narratives that are clear, engaging and designed to support a commercial outcome.
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and/or Canva, alongside strong Adobe Creative Suite skills, particularly InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator and After Effects.
* Strong typography, layout, visual hierarchy, image curation and information-design skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Experience working with brand guidelines, rights-holder and partner IP, logo lock-ups, image permissions and design systems across multiple deliverables.
* Comfortable designing for presentations and digital formats, with motion, video, Figma or interactive-design experience advantageous.

* Experience using AI or emerging creative tools as part of a thoughtful, quality-led design process.
* A confident communicator who can interpret a brief, ask the right questions, articulate design decisions and collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, ideally with exposure to international or cross-regional teams.
* Familiarity with workflow and project management tools, such as Asana, and an understanding of structured task-tracking processes.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor and guide other creatives, build effective relationships across the business, and develop towards future people-management responsibilities.

**Skills and Abilities**

* You are a designer first: creatively ambitious, commercially aware and motivated by making complex ideas simple, compelling and memorable.
* You are a natural visual storyteller who understands how composition, typography, imagery, data and motion work together to create a persuasive partnership narrative.
* You have exceptional craft and a sharp eye for detail, but you never lose sight of the audience, the brief or the commercial objective.
* You are confident developing a point of view, presenting your work and constructively challenging feedback when it compromises clarity, consistency or quality.
* You are highly organised and able to move between strategic thinking, hands-on design, stakeholder collaboration and final production without losing momentum.
* You are calm and solutions-focused under pressure, with the judgement to prioritise what matters when deadlines are tight.
* You are collaborative, generous with your knowledge and comfortable working as part of a distributed global team.
* You are curious about sport, culture, brands, technology and emerging creative practices, and you actively look for better ways to tell stories.

In addition, success at IMG is driven by four **core competencies** that apply to all employees:

  

* **Business Acumen** – Understanding financial drivers, interpreting business data, aligning decisions to strategic outcomes

* **Operational Excellence** – Driving efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement in delivery & operations

* **Innovation Mindset** – Cultivating curiosity, experimentation, and forward-looking capability development

* **Leadership & Collaboration** – Inspiring others, building trust, and enabling collaboration across teams

**Working Conditions**

* This is a permanent position
* This role will be based at Chiswick Park, with some flexibility on remote working as appropriate
* Working hours are 9:00 – 17:00, Monday to Friday
* May be required to attend and travel to other IMG buildings, meetings, industry events or on-site productions as necessary.
* Unsocial hours may be required, as dictated by the demands of the business schedule, including when working to a pitch or proposal deadline.

Our active Diversity & Inclusion network, comprehensive well-being programs, and clear sustainability strategies reflect this commitment.

London - £140K - £175K - Offers Equity

is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

## The role in one line

As our first EMEA Strategic Customer Success Manager, you'll help define what strategic success looks like at, and become the trusted partner who makes us core to how the biggest enterprises run reliability.

## What that looks like day to day

You'll work with a small number of our largest, most complex and highest-value customers. These are established, often global and regulated enterprises, where buying decisions take time, many business units are involved, and incident management is part of a wider move away from legacy tools and processes. You'll be their strategic partner across the full lifecycle, from early involvement in the deal with Sales through to adoption and expansion, and from the on-call engineer to the CIO and CTO.

You'll help land strategic logos with focused first contracts, then build the business case and success plan that turns them into larger deals. From there you'll expand across the enterprise, mapping the organisation, finding champions and repeating proven wins across business units and regions. You'll run Executive Business Reviews and connect our leadership with theirs, tying what we do to what matters to their business: operational resilience, regulatory risk, the cost of downtime, tool consolidation, MTTR reduction and incident process maturity.

You'll lead onboarding and migrations in organisations that move carefully, moving them off legacy tools and ITSM-led processes and making the change stick, including deeper adoption across Response, On-call, Status Pages and our AI capabilities. You'll spot and reduce business, operational and reputational risk before it becomes visible, and bring Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing and Support together around shared goals for each account, including expansion and renewals.

You'll also work directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap and design partnerships. As the first EMEA Strategic CSM and third on the team overall, you'll help define our strategic CS playbook, support high-stakes deals and help develop your peers as the segment grows.

## Who you are

* You have significant experience in Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management, managing strategic or Fortune 500-scale accounts in enterprise SaaS. Traditional enterprises like financial services, insurance, pharma, retail or private equity are ideal. Developer tooling, observability or incident management is a plus.
* You've driven adoption, retention and expansion in large, complex accounts with many stakeholders, and you have results you can point to.
* You know how to land small and grow large, turning a pilot or single business unit into a multi-BU footprint over a long sales cycle.
* Building a business case doesn't faze you, nor does navigating procurement, security, legal and change management in slow-moving organisations.
* You're confident with senior technical executives, running EBRs and strategic planning sessions, and just as comfortable going deep with SREs and platform engineers.
* You're technically fluent in modern engineering organisations, on-call, incident response, SRE practices and the observability and DevOps ecosystem, and you can translate it for business stakeholders.
* You have strong commercial judgement, partner well with Sales on renewals and expansion, and get ahead of customer challenges rather than reacting to them.
* You're autonomous and comfortable with ambiguity. You're excited to define the role, not just step into it.

## Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

* **Private medical insurance.** Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.
* **Competitive annual leave.** Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.
* **First Friday of every month off.** Yes, seriously.
* **Enhanced pension.** We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.
* **Meaningful equity.** We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.
* **Unlimited AI spend.** For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.
* **Generous parental leave.** The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.
* **Two budgets that have your back.** £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

## At InPost we hire awesome people who aren’t afraid to bring ideas to the table, to make mistakes, and challenge the norm!

Want to be part of a UK hub, in a global business that is scaling rapidly, evolving fast and radically changing the decades-old delivery universe? If so, read on — we're looking for a Finance Business Partner to join our Controlling team and become a trusted financial partner to one of our key business areas.

Our mission? To switch up the status quo and become the UK’s leading out-of-home business. With a fast-growing network of thousands of smart lockers, hundreds of leading retail partners and the launch of our transformative Send service, we’re bringing freedom to anyone with a parcel.

At InPost UK, we’re building an unparalleled group of talent that’s committed to help us power our mission to reshape the way parcels move, and redefine eCommerce logistics. Our team is packed full of top-notch experts in e-commerce, technology, scale-up growth, sustainability, logistics and supply chain. We’re a passionate bunch with high ambition – we collaborate, innovate, support each other, and leave egos at the door.

**About the role:**

This is a commercially focused finance role within the Controlling function. The Finance Business Partner is embedded in a specific area of the UK&I business — which may be Network, Commercial, Pricing, Operations, Newstrade or another function depending on team structure — acting as the primary Finance presence for that area. The role is equally outward-facing and inward-facing: outward to the business leaders and budget holders who rely on clear financial insight to make better decisions, and inward to the Financial Accounting team whose ledger outputs underpin everything the FBP produces. It is a role for someone who is commercially curious, analytically rigorous and confident enough to challenge as well as support.

**What you’ll be doing:**

**Finance Business Partnering**

• Act as the primary Finance contact for your assigned business area — building a close, trusted relationship with the relevant Director, Head of Function and their leadership team, and positioning Finance as an indispensable partner to how decisions are made in that part of the business.

• Attend leadership and management meetings for your business area — contributing financial perspective in real time, providing challenge where assumptions are stretched or risks are underweighted, and ensuring commercial decisions are made with a clear understanding of their financial consequences.

• Develop a genuine understanding of the commercial and operational drivers of your business area — going beyond the numbers to understand how the business works, what matters to the people you partner, and what the financial data is really telling them.

• Act as a proactive financial adviser rather than a reactive reporter — identifying financial risks and opportunities within your area before they surface in the management accounts, and bringing them to the attention of your business partners and the relevant Head of Finance with clear analysis and recommended actions.

• Support your business area in building financial literacy and cost accountability — helping non-finance leaders understand their numbers, take ownership of variances, and manage their P&L with confidence rather than relying on Finance to interpret everything for them.

**Monthly Performance Reporting & Commentary**

• Own the production of the monthly financial reporting pack for your assigned business area — ensuring actuals are accurate, variance commentary is insightful and the output gives business leaders a clear, timely picture of performance against plan.

• Write variance commentary that explains rather than describes — going beyond identifying that a number has moved to understanding why it has moved, what it means for the full-year position and what action is or should be being taken.

• Ensure reporting outputs are consistent with the consolidated UK&I management accounts — working with the relevant Head of Finance and other Finance Business Partners to ensure the overall picture is coherent and that intra-business movements are properly explained.

• Continuously improve the quality, relevance and speed of management reporting for your business area — identifying where reports can be made more actionable, where automation can reduce production time, and where new metrics would better serve the business.

**Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Planning**

• Own the budget and re-forecast process for your assigned business area — working with budget holders to build robust, well-evidenced plans from the bottom up, challenging assumptions that lack rigour, and ensuring the final plan is deliverable and clearly explained to both the business and the relevant Head of Finance.

• Lead rolling forecast updates for your area throughout the year — maintaining an accurate and current view of the full-year financial outlook, ensuring any material changes to forecast are identified, explained and escalated promptly, and that the forward-looking picture reflects what the business genuinely expects to happen rather than what was planned.

• Provide financial modelling and scenario analysis to support decision-making in your business area — including investment cases, pricing proposals, volume scenario analysis, cost lever evaluation and any other financial modelling required to support commercial or operational decisions.

• Contribute to the UK five-year plan (5YP) for your area — working with your business stakeholders to develop a credible, commercially grounded multi-year financial view that is consistent with the overall UK&I strategic plan.

**Working with the Financial Accounting Team**

• Build and maintain a strong, collaborative day-to-day working relationship with the Financial Controllers — understanding the accounting basis of the numbers you report, and ensuring that any differences between ledger actuals and management reporting are understood, explained and resolved.

• Provide the Financial Controllers with timely, clear context on business events that will affect the close — including material accruals, one-off items, recharges, timing differences or any other events that should be reflected in the month-end ledger — ensuring the accounting team is never surprised by what the management accounts show.

• Work with the Financial Controllers and Head of Financial Accounting to agree and maintain a clear close governance framework for your area — including cut-off rules, accrual methodologies, inter-entity recharge bases and cost allocation approaches — so that the transition from locked ledger to management commentary is seamless and low-friction.

• Act as the bridge between the business and the Financial Accounting team — translating commercial events into accounting requirements for the Financial Controllers, and translating accounting outputs into business-relevant insight for your stakeholders. The quality of this interface is a direct determinant of the quality of management reporting.

• Participate in joint Financial Accounting and Controlling team meetings, close reviews and planning sessions — contributing a business-facing perspective to ledger governance decisions and ensuring the two functions operate as a single, well-integrated Finance team rather than two separate functions that happen to produce related outputs.

**Investment Appraisal & Business Cases**

Intelance is a UK advisory firm working on technology governance, cyber security and data governance. Tasks
Review the data protection and security sections of the platform's terms of use, and redraft them so they are clear and consistent.
Set out the client's position as data controller when users in other countries can see data that is stored in the EU, and the safeguards it needs.
Check the supplier's data processing agreement against how the platform is really used.
Write plain English answers to the data protection questions that platform users keep asking.
Prepare a short list of points for the client's UK solicitor to confirm, and work alongside a law firm that is advising on China's data protection law.
Hand over cleanly to the Intelance colleague who will update the client's data security policy.
Requirements
5 years or more working in data protection or privacy, as a consultant, data protection officer or in-house adviser.
Hands on experience of international data transfers under UK GDPR and EU GDPR, including Standard Contractual Clauses, the UK International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum, and transfer risk assessments.
You have reviewed or drafted terms of use, data processing agreements or privacy notices for a software platform.
A recognised qualification such as CIPP/E or the BCS Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection.
You write short, clear documents that people outside legal and IT can act on.
Right to work in the UK, and able to work through your own limited company or as a self-employed contractor.
Desirable: working knowledge of China's Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL).
Desirable: experience with charities, standards or certification bodies, or supply chain platforms.

Day rate of £500 to £625, depending on experience.
About 2 days of work over the first 2 weeks, with a short follow-up if the client's solicitor raises points.

Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

### **About the External Drug Discovery Operations team**

We are establishing a new, centralised External Drug Discovery Operations group to serve as the operational engine for all externalised wet-lab research across Isomorphic Labs. Partnering directly with Drug Discovery & Medical Research (DDMR) and Data Generation teams, this centre of excellence orchestrates, oversees, and scales our global Contract Research Organisation (CRO) footprint. Comprising CRO Scientific Leads, CRO Operations Managers, and Compound Managers, the team ensures high-throughput, high-fidelity data generation.

### **Your impact**

The Head of External Drug Discovery Operations is a highly impactful role to drive and optimise how we utilise external partners to accelerate our pipeline delivery. You will lead all externalised drug discovery and preclinical laboratory activities, bridging wet-lab execution and enterprise data strategy. You will design, establish, and scale a modern CRO infrastructure tailored for an AI-first drug design platform, ensuring external workflows yield structured metadata, standardised assays, and automated ingestion pipelines across diverse therapeutic modalities. # Associate Director/Director Corporate Development & Partnership

IXICO plc (AIM: IXI), is a global leader in neuroscience imaging and biomarker analytics, using its proprietary AI-driven platform to help advance the treatment of neurological disorders and reduce the uncertainties associated with drug discovery, development and monitoring. **This position may be appointed at either Associate Director or Director level, depending on the successful candidate’s experience, expertise and demonstrated capabilities.**

* Support long-term strategic planning activities with the executive leadership team.

* Support commercial negotiations and partnership structuring activities and actively manage strategic alliances post-signature to ensure strong governance, relationship health, delivery against shared objectives, and value realisation.

* Co-lead and coordinate financial, operational, and commercial due diligence activities.
* Build financial models, valuation analyses, and transaction materials to support M&A decision-making.
* Support integration planning and post-transaction execution activities where relevant.

# **Building the Future of Open Finance**

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

## **The team**

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Join our Product and Regulatory Legal team, embedded with Kraken's Product, Design and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We are a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice, partnering directly with Product, senior leadership and Compliance to chart clear, defensible paths to launch and to keep our licensed entities running smoothly.

This is a senior product-facing legal role for the European Union. You will be the lawyer the business trusts on questions that cut across several regimes at once: for example, a single product such as a tokenised equity, a card, or an institutional custody and prime brokerage service can touch the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive ("MiFID II"), the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation ("MiCA"), the Payment Services Directive ("PSD2"), the Electronic Money Directive ("EMD2") and banking rules at the same time. You will bring clarity on which regime applies, what it requires, and how to launch within it.

## **The opportunity**

Reporting to the Head of Product Legal, you will act as a senior legal adviser to European leadership on new products, licensing structure and regulatory strategy.

* Own cross-functional product counselling for European Union launches from discovery to design, launch and iteration, giving Product, Engineering, Compliance and leadership decision-ready advice with clear options and risk trade-offs
* Advise on the regulatory perimeter and classification of new offerings across MiFID II and the Markets in Financial Instruments Regulation ("MiFIR"), MiCA, the European Market Infrastructure Regulation ("EMIR"), payment services and electronic money rules, and banking regulation, including where an instrument or service falls between regimes (for example tokenised securities, crypto-asset derivatives, margin and financing, and stablecoin-linked products)
* Advise on payments and electronic money offerings, including the Krak card and account propositions, safeguarding, open banking and account-access obligations, and the developing Payment Services Directive 3 and Payment Services Regulation framework
* Advise on banking-related questions that arise in the European Union, including bank partnerships and sponsor-bank arrangements, deposit-taking and lending perimeter questions, the Capital Requirements Regulation and Directive, and the interaction of these rules with our custody, prime brokerage and financing products
* Monitor and interpret European Union legislative and supervisory developments, take part in consultations and industry association work where appropriate, and translate their significance for the business proactively
* Draft and negotiate client-facing terms and conditions, taking clear, business-aligned positions
* Act as gatekeeper for European Union outside counsel engagements: scope the work, estimate and manage cost, and sign off before matters go externally
* Mentor and develop more junior lawyers in the team, set quality standards for plain-English, risk-based advice, and act as a senior sounding board for colleagues across the Regulatory Legal team
* Use AI-assisted tools (for example Enterprise GPTs) to speed up regulatory analysis, first drafts and matter tracking, and to build self-service tools that let stakeholders answer commoditised legal and regulatory questions themselves
* Advise on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing requirements affecting products, including the Transfer of Funds Regulation ("Travel Rule") and the new European Union anti-money laundering package, and on market abuse, conduct, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including the Digital Operational Resilience Act ("DORA")
* Lead or oversee licensing, authorisation and variation workstreams in the European Union, including scoping requirements, mapping pathways, supervising outside counsel, preparing application materials and managing regulator interactions

## **What you bring**

* Qualified lawyer admitted in Ireland, England and Wales, or another European Union Member State
* 15 or more years' post-qualification experience ("PQE") in financial services regulatory law, gained at a regulated financial services institution (for example a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, central counterparty or crypto services provider) or at a leading law firm supporting such clients, ideally with in-house or direct product counselling experience
* Deep, current knowledge of several of the following, with real depth in at least two: MiFID II and MiFIR (investment services, market structure, derivatives and conduct), MiCA (crypto-asset services, custody, trading platforms and stablecoins), European Union payment services and electronic money regulation, and European Union banking regulation
* Demonstrated ability to analyse novel products against overlapping regimes and give a clear view on classification and perimeter, including in areas where the rules are unsettled or supervisors have not yet spoken
* Direct experience managing senior regulator relationships, including notifications, information requests, supervisory correspondence and examinations
* Working knowledge of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including DORA
* Proven ability to instruct, supervise and manage the cost of outside counsel across multiple jurisdictions
* Outstanding analytical, drafting and organisational skills, with crisp, plain-English writing
* Ability to distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders and for senior leadership
* A pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that gives stakeholders a useful range of options and a clear recommendation
* Experience mentoring or managing lawyers, and the judgement to know when to escalate
* Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving, remote environment
* Familiarity with using AI tools such as Enterprise GPTs to increase the efficiency of legal services

## **Nice to haves**

* Experience advising on tokenised securities and the European Union Distributed Ledger Technology Pilot Regime
* Experience with EMIR, including the clearing obligation, margin for non-centrally cleared derivatives and transaction reporting
* Experience with prime brokerage, securities financing, margin lending or institutional custody
* Experience advising on the United Kingdom cryptoasset regime or other non-European Union frameworks that intersect with European Union operations
* Experience supporting regulatory aspects of corporate transactions, such as change-of-control notifications and entity migrations
* Experience with European Union data protection and consumer protection rules as they apply to financial products
* Fluency in a second European language
* An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward's and competitors' products

## Job Description

Lazard is one of the world’s preeminent financial advisory and asset management firms. **Our people and culture make the difference**. While global in presence and reach, ours is a close, collaborativecommunity of just over 3,000 professionals. Lazard is a place of continuous knowledge sharing, skill development and relationship building, where professionals grow and succeed together. Our entrepreneurial culture, flat structure and embrace of individual differences, allow creative ideas, original concepts, and unique perspectives to drive our business forward — and for careers to take flight.

Many of the world’s leading investors — from individuals to institutions across the globe — have entrusted Lazard Asset Management. We pride ourselves in uncovering the best investment opportunities for our clients. The purpose of our asset management business is to help our clients invest for the future — whether it’s for retirement, to grow and preserve inter-generational wealth, or to benefit the organizations that make our world smarter, healthier and more sustainable.

**Role Profile:**

Lazard Asset Management's Advantage Quantitative Equity team is hiring a Senior Quantitative Data Analyst to take ownership of the quality, reliability, and usability of the quantitative datasets that power our research and production investment workflows. These datasets are the direct inputs to factor models, risk models, alpha signals, backtests, and live portfolio construction - data quality here has real investment consequences.

This is a hands-on, senior role. You will take over our existing datasets, some of which need care and attention, and make sure they are in standard, consistent forms. You will extend and improve our history (longer coverage, higher frequency) and expand the data we have.

You will also build the automated validation, monitoring, and investigation tooling that keeps our data reliable. The goal is a durable suite of programmatic solutions that lets you and the rest of the team detect, diagnose, and resolve issues quickly.

The role combines data analysis and data engineering. You will be a data specialist who can also model datasets, design and improve tables and schemas, work directly with our databases, and build the pipelines that load and maintain them. You will join our London team and work closely with our team in the Boston and New York offices. The team is small and the work is consequential, with short feedback loops and close collaboration with our quantitative researchers and portfolio managers.

This role requires substantial hands-on experience with quantitative financial data in an investment setting - vendor feeds, time-series datasets, and the data quality problems specific to systematic investing. Candidates without that background are unlikely to be a fit.

**We'll trust you to:**

* Own quant datasets (market data, fundamentals, corporate actions, identifiers/reference data) end to end: their structure, lineage, known quirks, and intended use in research and production. It is on you to make sure the data is fit for use and that data projects keep moving.
* Assess the current state of our datasets, prioritise remediation, and make incremental improvements to existing tables and databases, including restructuring them where needed.
* Model and design datasets: choose the right grain, keys, and history handling (e.g. slowly changing reference data vs. daily time series, point-in-time / as-known storage), and implement those designs in our databases.
* Extend and enrich datasets: longer history, higher frequency (e.g. monthly to daily), additional coverage.
* Onboard new datasets end to end: profiling, schema/coverage validation, identifier mapping and normalisation, cross-source reconciliation, documentation, and support for productionisation.
* Build and maintain automated data validation and monitoring (completeness, timeliness, duplication, outliers, stale/missing series, mapping breaks), with clear quality metrics and dashboards - implemented in code, not spreadsheets.
* Build investigation tools and reusable libraries that let you and the team diagnose data issues quickly and self-serve on data questions.
* Investigate data anomalies affecting research or production output: triage, isolate root cause, quantify impact, coordinate remediation, and write the code that prevents recurrence.
* Build and maintain data pipelines and DAGs - ingestion, transformation, backfills, and reruns - and collaborate with quant developers to harden and operationalise them.
* Act as the primary point of contact with data vendors on issues affecting your datasets; evaluate new sources and vendor changes.
* Set and maintain conventions for dataset documentation, quality standards, and operational runbooks across the data ecosystem.
* Use AI tools effectively in your work - for coding, investigating issues, and detecting anomalies.

**You'll need to have:**

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 5+ years of relevant experience, working with quantitative financial data at an investment firm - e.g., a quantitative asset manager, systematic hedge fund, or other buy-side environment.
* Hands-on experience with several core dataset types - prices/returns, fundamentals, corporate actions, security master / reference data, factor data, risk model inputs - from at least two major vendors such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv/LSEG, S&P/Compustat, FactSet, MSCI, or ICE.
* Solid understanding of the data quality challenges specific to systematic investing: point-in-time correctness, survivorship bias, staleness, partial trading days, identifier changes (CUSIP/ISIN/SEDOL/ticker), and corporate action adjustments.
* Experience reconciling across sources and managing vendor schema/definition changes over time.
* Strong Python, including pandas and NumPy: able to write clean, maintainable code independently, organise it into reusable libraries used across a codebase, and build validations and automation of real substance. This is not a light scripting role.
* Strong SQL: multi-table joins, aggregations, window functions, and CTEs, used to investigate and reconcile discrepancies across large analytical datasets.
* Data modeling and database experience: designing schemas and tables for financial time-series and reference data (grain, keys, history/versioning), and working hands-on with relational or analytical databases, including a working sense of performance (indexing, partitioning, query plans).
* Strong analytical and debugging judgement; able to diagnose data inconsistencies systematically, prioritise among competing issues, and drive fixes to completion.
* Strong communication skills; effective working with a distributed team (London, Boston, and New York) and directly with researchers and vendors.

**Desirable Qualifications**

* Experience with pipelines and orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar) - strongly preferred.
* Practical experience applying AI tools to data work (coding assistance, investigation, anomaly detection).
* Experience supporting production data pipelines and incident workflows (monitoring, alerts, runbooks, operational readiness).
* Familiarity with modern data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake) and/or analytical engines (e.g., DuckDB, Polars); deeper query optimisation on large datasets.
* Version control (Git), testing, and code review practices.
* Cloud experience (we use Azure); familiarity with CI/CD.

This is a high-impact leadership role within the Data & Analytics (D&A) assurance function.

You will lead complex client assurance engagements, including DORA client audits and ISAE 3000 attestations, working directly with clients, external auditors and senior partners across Technology, Product, Risk, Information Security, Legal and Compliance.

## **Role Purpose**

The Maintenance Manager is responsible for leading the safe, reliable and efficient maintenance of the Lumentum Caswell site, including buildings, production support services, utilities and critical infrastructure.

The role will ensure that maintenance activities support business continuity, production requirements, compliance obligations and the planned site ramp-up. The Maintenance Manager will drive a proactive maintenance culture, reduce equipment failures and ensure that all work is planned, controlled and completed to the required standards.

## **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage the site maintenance team and maintenance contractors.
* Develop and deliver the planned preventative maintenance programme.
* Reduce reactive maintenance, repeat failures and unplanned downtime.
* Ensure maintenance activities are completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with site procedures.
* Maintain high standards across critical infrastructure, including:
  + HVAC and cleanroom systems
  + Electrical distribution and standby power systems
  + UPS and DRUPS systems
  + Chillers, compressors and air-handling units
  + UPW, CDA, nitrogen and vacuum systems
  + Fire, life-safety and emergency systems
  + Building fabric and associated services
  + BMS and control systems
* Ensure all statutory inspections, testing and certification are completed on time.
* Maintain accurate maintenance records, asset registers and compliance documentation.
* Manage maintenance budgets, purchase orders, suppliers and contractor performance.
* Ensure all contractors are appropriately approved, inducted and controlled while on site.
* Plan and coordinate maintenance activities around production requirements, using Green-to-Green planning where applicable.
* Ensure all planned interruptions are properly assessed, communicated and approved.
* Support investigations into equipment failures, incidents and near misses, ensuring effective corrective actions are implemented.
* Lead root-cause analysis and continuous-improvement activities.
* Work closely with Production, Engineering, EHS, Quality, Facilities and Project teams.
* Provide clear weekly and monthly reports to the Senior WPS Manager.
* Support capital projects, commissioning, handover and acceptance of new equipment and systems.
* Ensure maintenance strategies are suitable for the site’s future production ramp-up and business-continuity requirements.
* Promote strong housekeeping, safety ownership and professional standards across the maintenance function.

## **Health, Safety and Compliance**

The Maintenance Manager will:

* Ensure compliance with Lumentum policies, statutory requirements and safe systems of work.
* Maintain effective permit-to-work, isolation and lockout/tagout controls.
* Ensure risk assessments and method statements are suitable and implemented.
* Stop unsafe work and escalate significant risks immediately.
* Support audits, inspections and compliance reviews.
* Ensure environmental, fire, electrical and statutory obligations are effectively managed.

## **Performance Measures**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Improved asset reliability and availability.
* Reduction in reactive maintenance and repeat failures.
* Delivery of the planned maintenance programme.
* Reduced maintenance-related production interruptions.
* Completion of statutory inspections and compliance actions on time.
* Effective contractor and supplier performance.
* Accurate maintenance records and reporting.
* Delivery of maintenance activities within budget.
* Positive feedback from production and site stakeholders.
* Demonstrable improvements in safety, housekeeping and maintenance standards.

## **Experience and Qualifications**

Essential:

* Proven experience managing maintenance activities within a complex industrial, manufacturing, laboratory or critical-environment facility.
* Experience managing multi-skilled engineering teams and contractors.
* Strong knowledge of planned preventative and condition-based maintenance.
* Experience with electrical, mechanical, HVAC and building-services systems.
* Experience of managing maintenance budgets, suppliers and service contracts.
* Good understanding of health and safety legislation and compliance requirements.
* Ability to plan work around operational and production constraints.
* Strong communication, organisational and problem-solving skills.

Desirable:

* Experience working in semiconductor, microelectronics, cleanroom, pharmaceutical or other high-reliability environments.
* Experience with CMMS or maintenance-management systems.
* Electrical, mechanical, facilities or building-services qualification.
* IOSH, NEBOSH or equivalent health and safety qualification.
* Experience supporting capital projects and equipment commissioning.
* Knowledge of business continuity, critical utilities and resilience planning.

## **Personal Attributes**

The successful candidate will be:

* Safety-focused and willing to challenge unsafe behaviour.
* Proactive, organised and able to prioritise competing demands.
* Calm and decisive during equipment failures or site incidents.
* Commercially aware and able to manage budgets effectively.
* A strong leader who develops people and sets clear expectations.
* Customer-focused, with a clear understanding of production needs.
* Collaborative and able to work effectively across departments.
* Analytical, with a structured approach to problem-solving.
* Accountable for delivering agreed actions and standards.

## **Authority and Accountability**

The Maintenance Manager will have authority to:

* Direct and prioritise maintenance activities.
* Stop unsafe work or work that presents an unacceptable operational risk.
* Escalate critical asset and compliance risks to the Senior WPS Manager.
* Approve routine maintenance activities within delegated authority.
* Recommend improvements to maintenance strategy, resourcing and site infrastructure.
* Hold contractors and service providers accountable for agreed performance.

The Maintenance Manager will remain accountable to the Senior WPS Manager for the safe, compliant, reliable and cost-effective delivery of site maintenance.

* Credibility with senior stakeholders and the ability to communicate financial concepts clearly to non-finance audiences.

* Practical experience using modern systems, data, AI and automation to improve the quality and speed of finance work.

**Desirable**

* Experience supporting board, investor or fundraising processes.
* A professional accounting qualification or relevant background in investment banking, consulting or investing.
* Familiarity with business-intelligence tools and financial-planning platforms.

## Job Description

Verisk is a global data, analytics, and technology company helping organizations make better-informed decisions about risk.

Within Verisk, Maplecroft combines data, technology, and deep subject-matter expertise to help organizations understand and respond to complex global risks. Its risk intelligence covers areas including climate, human rights, political, economic, and environmental risk, helping organizations make more informed decisions across their operations, investments, and supply chains.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our backend engineering team and help build the APIs and workflows behind the next generation of our client-facing technology.

This is a hands-on engineering role with meaningful ownership. You will write production Python, make technical decisions, and take work from early design through deployment and ongoing improvement. You will also have the opportunity to use AI-assisted development pragmatically to improve how you build, test, and deliver software.

If you enjoy solving substantial backend engineering problems and want your work to support products with a clear real-world purpose, this is an opportunity to do that within the stability and scale of Verisk.

**Why joining Verisk Maplecroft**

The difference here is the context in which you will be engineering.

Maplecroft has built its business around turning complex global risk into useful intelligence for decision-makers. Its Country Risk Data covers more than 190 political, regulatory, social, climate, nature, and economic risks worldwide.

Technology is central to delivering that intelligence. Maplecroft’s existing technology landscape includes the Global Risk Dashboard, its client-facing risk analytics platform, alongside large-scale data processing technology and the development of its next-generation risk management platform

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will have the opportunity to:

•   Own meaningful backend engineering work rather than simply receiving development tasks.

•   Build production Python and Django services that support client-facing technology.

•   Influence engineering decisions around architecture, security, reliability, testing, and maintainability.

•   Work closely with product, QA, platform, and engineering colleagues throughout the full software lifecycle.

•   Help evolve how the team develops software through automation, modern engineering practices, and responsible use of AI-assisted development.

•   Apply your engineering skills to data and technology designed to help organizations understand complex global risks.

You will be joining a specialist risk intelligence business while benefiting from being part of the broader Verisk organization. Maplecroft itself highlights this combination, noting that being part of Verisk provides access to the resources and expertise of a leading strategic data, analytics, and technology company. We have our main office in Bath, but we can offer a full remote contract for this position within UK.

job_description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Manager, Global SME Credit Product Management
Overview:
Mastercard’s Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) business is focused on enabling small businesses to start, grow and thrive through innovative payment products, solutions and experiences.

The Manager, Global SME Credit Product Manager will play a key role in developing Mastercard’s global entry-level credit proposition for small businesses, with a focus on expanding access to credit and enabling issuers to serve new and underserved SME segments.

A key priority for the role will be supporting the establishment and launch of a new global program designed to accelerate credit issuance to small businesses. The Manager will work across global and regional teams to develop the proposition, bring the program to market and drive adoption and scale.

Role:
• Be a key member of the global Small Business Credit team, helping to build and evolve a best-in-class credit proposition for SMEs globally
• Drive the development and growth of Mastercard’s entry-level SME credit products, ensuring the proposition addresses the needs of small businesses and issuers across different markets
• Support the establishment and launch of a new global SME credit program designed to accelerate credit issuance and expand access to credit for small businesses
• Support the development of the program strategy, value proposition, product requirements, operating model and commercialization approach
• Conduct market, customer, and competitive analysis to identify unmet market needs, emerging trends and opportunities to strengthen Mastercard’s SME credit offering
• Size market and commercial opportunities, develop business cases and use data and insights to support product decisions
• Translate strategy and customer needs into clear product requirements and work with cross-functional teams to steer initiatives through the product development lifecycle from concept to launch
• Partner closely with regional teams to identify priority markets and customers, build a pipeline of opportunities and support issuer commercialization

All About You
• Experience in product management, product strategy, payments, commercial cards (preferably small business) or related financial services field 
• Experience or demonstrated interest in small business financial inclusion, small business lending, underserved segments or solutions designed to expand access to financing is highly valued
• Strong interest in small business credit and the role payments and financial services can play in expanding access to credit
• Analytically minded, with the ability to size opportunities, develop business cases and use data to inform product decisions and priorities
• Strong product management capabilities, with the ability to translate user and customer needs into product requirements and drive initiatives through development and commercialization
• Comfortable working with both commercial and technical stakeholders and developing an understanding of the capabilities and infrastructure required to deliver new products
• Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and drive execution across cross-functional teams
• Strong communication skills and ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations for different audiences
• Collaborative and comfortable working across global and regional teams in a matrixed organization
Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Our London Core Labs team builds ambitious products at the intersection of software, embedded systems, connectivity, video, computer vision, AI and medical technology. As a Senior Principal Product Manager for Touch Surgery Aide, you will shape the product strategy for the digital and edge-compute platform that powers the Touch Surgery ecosystem. ### **Data Protection Officer**

### **37 hours per week – Monday to Friday - Hybrid working model**

An excellent opportunity to join the in-house Governance Team.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Protection Officer.  This role is responsible for ensuring Methodist Homes (MHA) complies with all relevant data protection and privacy legislation, including the UK General Data Protection Regulations (UK GDPR), the Data Protection Act 2018, the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations and the Access to Health Records Act 1990. Reporting to the General Counsel/Company Secretary, the Data Protection Officer (DPO) acts as the organisation’s lead expert on data protection, providing advice, guidance, and assurance to managers, employees, and anyone processing personal data on MHA’s behalf. The role oversees the development, maintenance, and review of information governance policies to ensure that personal information is handled lawfully, securely, and in line with best practice.

The DPO serves as MHA’s central point of contact for data protection matters, including being the primary contact with the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO). The DPO also liaises with law enforcement agencies, local authorities, the NHS, law firms, and other third parties. The role leads the response to personal data breaches, ensuring incidents are investigated, reported to the ICO where required, corrective actions are implemented, and lessons learned are embedded across the organisation. The DPO also manages requests from individuals exercising their data protection rights and ensures these are handled promptly and effectively.

A key aspect of the role is monitoring and improving compliance across the organisation. This includes maintaining records required by legislation, conducting regular data protection audits and compliance reviews, managing the annual NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT) submission, and ensuring colleagues complete the required data protection and information governance training. The DPO is also responsible for promoting a culture of privacy by design, providing expert guidance on Data Protection Impact Assessments and Legitimate Interest Assessments, and ensuring high-risk processing activities are appropriately assessed and escalated where necessary.

We are ideally looking for:

* Significant experience in data protection and information governance.
* Expert knowledge of the UK GDPR, Data Protection Act 2018, Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR), and Access to Health Records Act 1990.
* A proven track record of maintaining compliance records and evidencing organisational accountability under data protection legislation.
* Experienced in implementing change and influencing organisational culture in response to legislative developments and regulatory guidance from the ICO.
* A highly motivated individual who can work independently.

Overview
Microsoft Research AI for Science seeks a motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to design and lead experimental data-generation campaigns for the next Biomolecular Emulator (BioEmu) model. Microsoft Research AI for Science focuses on the development of machine learning and artificial intelligence methods for transforming molecular simulation and discovery of novel materials, drugs and chemical reactions. The BioEmu project aims to model the dynamics and function of proteins, how they change shape, bind to each other, and bind small molecules. This approach will help us to understand biological function and dysfunction on a structural level and lead to more effective and targeted drug discovery. Our BioEmu-1 model was published in Science (see our blog post for links to our open-source software and other resources and this explainer video). 
This role is suited for researchers with either an experimental or computational background who are excited about connecting machine learning models with real-world biological measurements. They shall combine strong scientific judgement with clear communication, quantitative data interpretation and effective coordination across disciplines. The position does not include a dedicated wet-lab bench; experimental execution will primarily be carried out through external partners. This role emphasizes scientific ownership, cross-disciplinary collaboration, and scalable systems thinking, moving beyond one-off experiments or models to build reusable, high-impact data and modeling pipelines. 
Why this role is exciting 
You’ll be running very large-scale data generation campaigns to train next-generation AI methods that can make a meaningful impact on how biomolecular modeling is done and improve success rates in drug discovery. You provide your expertise on technical and design level, making decisions about and creating datasets that have crucial impact on our AI models. It’s an opportunity to bridge state‑of‑the‑art ML with meaningful biomedical impact in a highly collaborative research environment. 


Responsibilities
1.Experimental campaign design, including areas such as
Design scalable campaigns for biomolecular interactions, conformational dynamics and related protein measurements. 
Select systems, constructs, assays and controls based on scientific value, feasibility, diversity, throughput and cost. 
Anticipate bottlenecks and define success criteria, contingency plans and follow-up experiments. 
2. CRO and external-partner leadership, including areas such as
Translate research goals into clear work packages, milestones and experimental requirements. 
Coordinate parallel programs with CROs and academic collaborators, review progress and guide corrective iterations. 
Provide scientific direction on protein production, assay development and biophysical or structural characterization. 
3. Data quality and interpretation, including areas such as
Review raw and processed experimental outputs, including binding curves and kinetic measurements. 
Diagnose artifacts, failed fits and systematic assay problems using quantitative and biophysical reasoning. 
Define reproducible QC criteria and scalable triage processes beyond manual review. 
4. Dataset construction and model integration, including areas such as 
Convert heterogeneous experimental outputs into traceable, model-ready datasets with appropriate metadata and provenance. 
Work with computational researchers to prioritize systems, evaluate model predictions and design informative follow-up experiments. 
Use basic scripting and data-analysis tools to organize, inspect and summarize experimental datasets. 
5. Collaboration and research impact, including areas such as
Communicate experimental findings, limitations and risks to biological and computational collaborators. 
Drive projects from ambiguous questions to usable datasets, scientific conclusions and publications. 
Contribute to the experimental data strategy for future BioEmu models. 


Qualifications
Required/Minimum Qualifications: 
PhD in Biology, Biophysics, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Protein Science, Bioengineering, Computational Biology, Molecular Modelling, or a related field, with experience designing, conducting, or analyzing biomolecular experiments and/or computational studies.
Strong quantitative understanding of experimental measurements and their limitations. 
Ability to coordinate complex projects and communicate clearly across experimental and computational teams. 
Experience working with real-world biological, structural or biophysical datasets. 
Ability to independently own and deliver research projects. 
Preferred/Additional Qualifications: 
Experience managing CROs, vendors or distributed experimental collaborations. 
Expertise in protein-protein interactions, binder design, affinity optimization or high-throughput assay development. Familiar with techniques such as protein expression and purification, binding assays (SPR, BLI, ITC, cryo-EM), structural biology (X-ray crystallography, NMR), Mass Spec (HDX-MS, Cross-link Mass Spec). 
Practical Python or equivalent scripting skills for data analysis, QC and workflow automation. 
Experience in designing, curating or standardizing datasets for machine-learning applications. Interest in model-guided experimental design, drug discovery or therapeutic applications.

This is a new, high-visibility role with enterprise scope. This is a strategic knowledge and capability role, accountable for translating priority knowledge into practical application. You will set the knowledge and content strategy, establish the governance model, build a prioritised roadmap and source and curate content with subject matter experts. You will be accountable for the quality and coherence of the global layer, while business units remain free to create local content within agreed standards.

The role will succeed through judgement, influence and value creation. It must balance enterprise priorities with the realities of independently run businesses and make deliberate choices about what should be captured, standardised, scaled, signposted or managed within the businesses.

  

The role is remote and can be based in Eastern Canada or UK/Europe.

  

# **You will deliver**

## 1. Enterprise Knowledge Strategy and Roadmap

* **Set the strategy.** Define the enterprise knowledge and content strategy, aligned to Modaxo priorities and translated into a practical multi-year roadmap.

* **Build a repeatable sourcing model.** Build effective relationships and effective ways to source and identify potential stories.Create practical ways to extract expertise, lessons learned, playbooks and examples across Modaxo without placing unnecessary burden on business leaders and domain experts.

* **Protect critical expertise.** Identify institutional knowledge at risk through leadership changes, retirement, transformation or acquisition, and establish proportionate methods to capture and transfer it.

## 4. Priority Capability and Learning Content

* **Lead the content roadmap.** Translate Modaxo global priorities into a sequenced roadmap of flagship knowledge and learning content, with clear audiences, outcomes, owners and delivery routes for both business and functions.

## 7.   Knowledge Architecture and Governance

* **Design the architecture.** Establish a practical taxonomy, metadata and content model so people can find relevant knowledge by topic, role, business need, audience and format.
* **Set the quality bar.** Define minimum standards for accuracy, format, accessibility, ownership, approval, source attribution and review.

# AI Engineer

## About the role

We already run two kinds of agent alongside our teams. AI agents diagnose performance problems and tell people the root cause. Rule-based agents recommend marketing actions to our advertising teams. The quality of their decisions shows up directly in our revenue.

Next, both take a greater role in the day-to-day running of our lead generation business, moving from recommending, to acting with a person's approval, to acting on their own where it is safe. We need an engineer to build agents that are dependable in production, measurable, and safe to trust with more.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll own agents end to end, from understanding the workflow to running them in production, alongside our existing AI engineer, data scientists, product managers and the people who use the agents every day. Today we use Claude and open-weight models such as GLM, chosen per task on quality and cost, on an agent framework we build ourselves.

## 

## What you'll do

**Build agents**

* **Start from the workflow.** Sit with the operators, map how the work is actually done, and build for that, not for the process as documented.

* **Connect them to the business.** Using our data warehouse, internal services, and the APIs into the systems agents act in.
* **Turn outputs into results people trust.** Structured outputs, validation and clear application logic.

**Make them safe to trust**

* **Log every decision.** Each action records its context, what was chosen, and whether a person accepted or overrode it, so agents can be evaluated and improved.
* **Build the path to autonomy.** Per decision, agents move from recommend, to act with approval, to act alone. Our data scientists propose the bar from agreement and override data and point people in the business sign it off; you build the mechanism that enforces it on our shared agent framework, with permissions and guardrails in the code, not the prompt.
* **Evaluate behaviour, not just code.** Test sets, agreement with expert operators, and evaluation before and after every change.

# Senior Product Engineer - Partner Experience

London, GBEngineeringHybridposted today

Wise Platform helps banks, software companies, and large enterprises use Wise's infrastructure to offer their customers cross-border payment products through our API. We're a cross-functional team across sales, implementation, product, engineering, compliance, and analytics, based in New York, London, and Singapore. We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Partner Experience team in London. The Partner Experience team builds and runs the systems that let enterprise partners go live faster and manage their day-to-day operations in one place.

We own the Partner Portal (used by many big banks to manage transfers, report fraud, handle compliance requests, and manage their teams) and the backend services behind partner onboarding, permissions, and communication. Most of what we build is new. There's no existing playbook for enterprise partner tooling at this scale, so you'll be designing systems from scratch more often than maintaining existing ones.

### How we work

We're a small team that ships frequently and iterates on real partner feedback. Engineers own features from technical discovery and design through to production support. We work closely with our PM and designer to understand partner needs, and with adjacent teams (API Experience, Account Discovery, KYC, FinCrime) to pull their capabilities into the portal. We investigate before we build. That means managing ambiguity, understanding the existing systems, APIs and dependencies before writing code. We keep process light: quick standups, focused 1:1s, and quarterly planning.

What will you be working on?:

* Backend microservices for partner-facing features: fraud reporting, case management, RFI handling, audit logging, and transaction visibility.
* The permissions and role-based access control system that governs what partners can do in the portal.
* SSO (SAML 2.0) integration for enterprise partners, including solving identity mapping between partner systems and Wise.
* The communication layer services between Wise and partners, extending them to handle new case types and workflows.
* API design for partner-facing endpoints. We care about consistency, documentation, and making them usable without hand-holding.
* Work with FinCrime, Compliance, and KYC teams to bring sanctions RFI workflows and fraud reporting into the portal.
* Technical discovery: mapping existing systems, evaluating dependencies, producing design documents that become the team's source of truth.
* Production support and debugging when live partner issues come up.

## **About Niantic Spatial**

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

## **About the Role**

You’ll join our Research Team in London as a 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist/Engineer — working at both ends of the pipeline, from cutting-edge academic research to shipping directly to customers. Our team builds the reconstruction technology that turns casually captured or domain-specific imagery into high-fidelity 3D reconstructions: everything from Structure-from-Motion through 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward models, and generative models. We’ve shipped 360 splatting to consumers and enterprise customers, developed the splatting tech that runs on phones, and published at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH — more often than not, our papers end up in production.

You’ll work alongside world-class researchers in computer vision, machine learning, graphics, and robotics on large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, scene understanding, and geospatial foundation models. This role is open to junior and senior researchers; scope and responsibility are calibrated to your experience.

## **What You’ll Do**

* **Research & Publication** — Conduct original research in 3D computer vision, machine learning, and spatial AI; publish findings at top-tier venues including CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH.
* **Algorithm Development** — Design, implement, and evaluate novel algorithms across 3D reconstruction, neural scene representations, 3D Gaussian Splatting, SfM, meshing, geometric deep learning, feed-forward models, generative models, and spatial foundation models.
* **Research-to-Production** — Collaborate with research scientists and engineers to transition promising ideas into customer-facing products — working directly with real capture conditions, real hardware constraints, and real customers on short turnarounds.
* **Large-Scale Experimentation** — Build and run large-scale experiments and benchmarking frameworks to rigorously validate and advance new methods.
* **Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration** — Partner with world-class researchers in CV, ML, graphics, and robotics to advance large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, and geospatial foundation models.
* **Rapid Prototyping** — Implement and iterate on state-of-the-art methods for both academic publishing and production deployment, delivering working prototypes to enterprise customers with speed and quality.

## **What You’ll Bring**

* PhD in Computer Vision, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field — or equivalent demonstrated research experience in industry.
* A strong research track record in 3D computer vision: reconstruction, depth estimation, novel view synthesis, SfM, SLAM, or closely related areas.
* A meaningful publication record at top-tier venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, or equivalent).
* Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch.
* Evidence that you can carry an idea from research into something real — a shipped feature, a production pipeline, a widely used open-source release, or similar.
* The independence to drive research projects from idea generation through experimentation, publication, and handoff.

## **Nice to Have**

* Experience with classical reconstruction tooling (COLMAP or similar).
* C++ or CUDA experience, and a feel for performance and on-device constraints.
* Experience with traditional 3D techniques — meshing, texturing, or bringing modern geometry or generative representations into native 3D.
